description: Emergency calls, family contact, banking, aid registration, news and any ability to record what is happening. It is not an inconvenience layer; it is the layer everything else runs on.
energy_note: No ambulance, no mother, no proof.

aspect: It falls hardest on those least mobile
description: A person who can walk to find signal does. An elderly woman, a woman in late pregnancy, a mother with four children under eight, cannot.
energy_note: Signal exists two kilometres away, which may as well be Mars.

aspect: Not knowing is its own injury
description: Uncertainty about whether a specific person is alive produces a stress response that does not habituate, because there is no information to adapt to.
energy_note: The one state the mind cannot settle into.

aspect: EXAMPLE - Gaza has only ever had 2G
description: Wataniya was never able to begin operations in Gaza because of Israeli restrictions on spectrum and imports, leaving it a single-operator market that has only ever run 2G. When Israel agreed in November 2015 to permit 3G, the agreement covered the West Bank only.
energy_note: Two generations of mobile technology, never delivered at all.
